description:
Get a verified coin's creator record

The creator record of a verified coin: how many coins its creator launched before, how many are still trading and how many died within a week, when they first launched, how old the wallet is and who funded it, plus what the creator has done with this coin since (events) and "Bundled at open". Every label comes with its one-line definition. Read from chains and kept by Chain Daddy; the answer never calls a third party, so it can lag the chain by up to a day. `state` is `pending` until the record is first computed, and `offPlatformPending` stays `true` while launches on other platforms are still being read. Answers 404 for a ticker with no verified page on that chain, for a page Chain Daddy removed, and everywhere while the creator record is off. Keyless, the same for every caller, and cached for about a minute.

Any coin: put the token address where the ticker goes to read the creator record of a coin nobody registered with Chain Daddy. The answer then also names the creator (`creator`) and where the chain names them (`creatorSource`). It is `pending` until the creator and their launches have been read (seconds to minutes; cached for seconds, so it can be asked again), and `unknown` when the chain does not name a creator Chain Daddy can read. Reading a new coin's creator starts only for a request from a web browser; any other caller gets what is already known, or `pending`. A registered coin answers on its ticker, not its address.

chain.description: Chain key, lowercase, as in the page's own address (e.g. `base`, `solana`). A numeric chain ID answers 404.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker (letters and digits, any case), or the token address of a coin nobody registered

name: get_creator_record

outputSchema.description:
A coin creator's record, as Chain Daddy reads it from chains. Facts and counts only; every label
carries its definition.

backed.description:
The coin's own Backed vault, as its Terms card states it: the creator's fee share is held and paid
out only while their wallets keep what they committed. Absent when the launch has no vault.

cliffEnd.description: Nothing is paid before this (unix seconds)

committed.description: The wallets' holding is on record in the vault

forfeited.description: The hold broke and the creator's fees go to holders for good

heldPct.description: The wallets' own balance as a share of what they committed, as last read

holdUntil.description: The obligation ends here (unix seconds); absent means no end

minHoldPct.description: Share of the committed holding the wallets must keep

backedForfeited.description: How many of the creator's other launches forfeited their Backed vault. Absent when none.

creator.description: The creator's wallet, on a coin read by its address (absent on a registered coin)

creatorSource.description:
Where the chain names the creator, on a coin read by its address: `launchpad_record` (the
launch program's own record of its creator), `fee_share` (the coin's creator-fee config),
`launch_pool` (the pool the coin launched in), `mint_authority` (the mint's authority),
`creation_tx` (sent the creation transaction), `factory_call` (called the contract that
created it) or `payout_recipient` (the coin's payout recipient).

definitions.description: The one-line definition of each word the record uses, by key

events.description: What the creator did with this coin, newest first

kind.description:
`sell` (into the coin's pool), `moved_out` (to any other wallet), `creator_exited` (holds 10% or
less of what they launched with). Counts only the creator's own wallets.

evidence.description:
What the coin's own metadata names and whether it points back, what the coin shares with other
coins, and labels from a pinned classifier. Each line's definition is in `definitions`
(`links_back`, `named_on_coins`, `shared_with_coins`). Absent until there is something to show;
each part is absent when empty. Not part of the block rule.

classifierLabels.description: Labels from a pinned classifier, each answering one typed question

probability.description: How sure the classifier is, from 0 to 1

version.description: The pinned classifier version that answered

identityLinks.description: The sites and accounts the coin's metadata names

ageDays.description: How old the account, channel or site is, in days, where known

linksBack.description: Points back at the coin or its creator (`true`), was read and does not (`false`), or not read yet (`null`)

name.description: The site's host, or the account (`@name` on X and Telegram)

namedOnCoins.description: The sites and accounts in identityLinks that other coins' metadata also names, as read in the last 7 days

coins.description: How many coins name it, this one included

sharedWith.description: How many other coins have the same thing as this coin; a thing no other coin shares is absent

analyticsId.description: The same analytics or pixel id on their sites

certificate.description: The same TLS certificate on their sites

image.description: The same image, by perceptual hash

pinningAccount.description: The same pinning or gateway account behind their metadata

funderLabel.description: Who first funded the creator's wallet, when the funder is a known operator (e.g. an exchange)

holdings.description: What the creator holds of this coin. Absent until the coin is watched (it traded in the last 7 days).

launchPctSupply.description: Percent of supply they held at the watch's first reading of the coin

pctSupply.description: Percent of supply the creator's own wallets hold

team.description: Wallets the creator named (team, fee, fee sharers), shown apart

identity.description: What the creator proved about who they are. Absent when nothing is proved.

coinbaseVerified.description:
The creator's wallet holds Coinbase's "Verified Account" attestation on Base, as last
checked by the creator. Absent when not.

x.description: The creator's verified X account and the month it was created

category.description: On `flagged` only, the category a person at Chain Daddy set after reviewing reports. Neither the reviewer's notes nor any reporter is published.

definition.description: The label's one line, built from this coin's facts

launchesAlive.description: Of those, how many still trade (a trade in the last 7 days)

launchesDead7d.description: Of those, how many stopped trading within 7 days of launch

launchesTotal.description: Coins this creator launched, here and on other platforms

launchesUnknown.description: Of those, how many are neither still trading nor known to have stopped (no trade on record and no word on whether they left their launch curve). Stopped is launchesTotal − launchesAlive − launchesUnknown.

offPlatformPending.description: Launches on other platforms are still being read; counts may grow

openBlock.description: "Bundled at open": who bought in the coin's opening blocks (EVM: the launch block and the next 3; Solana: the first 30 slots). Absent when the opening blocks were not seen.

bundledPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by bundled wallets (3 or more buying in one block, or 2 or more in one block with the same funder)

bundledWallets.description: How many wallets bought in those blocks

buyers.description: Wallets that bought in the opening blocks

creatorLinkedPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets linked to the creator (wallets the creator controls, or funded by the creator or the creator's funder)

linkedPending.description: Links between the buyers and the creator are still being read

linkedWallets.description: How many opening buyers are linked to the creator

promoters.description:
Wallets this coin pays a share of its creator fees to (paid promotion), each with its record
from launches here. Omitted when the coin pays none. Not part of the block rule.

handle.description: Shown only when the promoter verified it

ownLaunches.description: Coins the promoter launched themselves, when any

paidLaunches.description: Launches here that paid them a share

sharePct.description: The share of the creator's fees this coin pays them, in percent

stillTrading.description: Of those, how many still trade

stoppedWithin7d.description: Of those, how many stopped trading within 7 days of launch

ruleHit.description: On a `blocked` record, the category of rule that blocked the creator; `definitions.rule` is the one line shown with it

state.description:
`pending` (not read yet), `first_launch` (no earlier launch found), `on_record` (earlier
launches found), `serial` (many launches, most dead within a week), `blocked` (refused new
launches here) or, for a coin read by its address, `unknown` (the chain names no creator
Chain Daddy can read).

supportEmail.description: On a `blocked` record, where the creator contests the block

title: Get a coin's creator record
